current_role: Co-founder, chairman and CEO of Blackstone
summary: Stephen Schwarzman co-founded the investment firm Blackstone in 1985 with his former Lehman Brothers colleague Peter G. Peterson and has led it since; it manages about $1.4 trillion. A major Republican donor, he chaired Trump's President's Strategic and Policy Forum until it disbanded in August 2017, and in May 2024 said he would back Trump as a "vote for change".
